Project: https://github.com/SarahWeiii/CoACD
Package: https://pypi.org/project/coacd/1.0.14/
The unchanged native library is from the official Windows cp39-abi3 wheel.
The package license and verified wheel download manifest are retained here.

This Windows x64 library is enabled for the Unity Editor only. It generates
separate collision assets; shipped Players use Unity's native PhysX and do
not load CoACD, MIConvexHull or a separate collision solver.

CoacdNative.cs adapts the public CoACD C ABI and releases native mesh arrays
after copying their data. It does not reimplement convex decomposition.
The pinned package's ctypes declarations are archived in
tmp/contact_audio_20261028/research/CoACD/coacd/__init__.py.
CoACD's real-metric threshold describes the algorithm's distance objective;
runtime contact geometry and approximation error are verified separately.
